'''Orion Ferret's shuttle''' was a small [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] owned by disreputable weapons trader [[Orion Ferret]]. The shuttle was docked at [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Bazarre]], Ferret's base of operations. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] used the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped shuttle to travel from Bazarre to [[Patch-4]] to retrieve four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] they purchased from Ferret.<ref name="Star Wars 59">[[Star Wars (1977) 59|''Star Wars'' (1977) 59]]</ref>

The shuttle had a remote ejection system that Ferret considered using to get rid of the two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and keep their money, the TIEs and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Though Calrissian and Skywalker were nearly killed on Patch-4, they eventually returned the shuttle to Bazarre. The shuttle was also equipped with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] that was used to tow the TIE fighters from Patch-4.<ref name="Star Wars 59" />
